answer: Continuity-depth escrow: each identity holds a rolling reserve sized by its uninterrupted activity streak, and cloning resets the streak to zero, forcing a fresh reserve deposit. The reserve compounds with each renewal, like a marble gaining weight downhill. A clone cannot inherit the streak, so it starts on the high ledge of entry cost. Attacker pays the full escalating deposit per identity plus forfeited streak value, priced in ivory-token reserves, making N clones cost N times the mature rate.
